title: Solana treasury firm SkyAI faces board challenge from would-be acquirer Forward Industries, shareholder group
summary: SkyAI’s proposed equity plan would authorize 5.145 million shares for stock-based compensation, representing roughly 7.2% additional dilution.
content: Solana treasury firm SkyAI is facing a board challenge from potential acquirer Forward Industries and a group of shareholders. The dispute follows SkyAI's proposed equity plan, which would authorize 5.145 million shares for stock-based compensation. This move represents approximately 7.2 percent in additional dilution for existing investors, sparking tensions regarding the company's future corporate governance and acquisition pressures.

title: Apple Unveils Redesigned Siri AI and A20 Pro Chip as CEO John Ternus Makes Debut
summary: The company's first fall keynote under new leadership paired a Gemini-powered Siri overhaul with Apple's first 2-nanometer chip, plus a $1,999 foldable iPhone that won't ship until October.
content: Apple has showcased a major overhaul of its Siri assistant powered by Gemini technology alongside its new A20 Pro chip. During the fall keynote led by new CEO John Ternus, the company also revealed a foldable iPhone priced at $1,999, which is scheduled for release in October.
